segments.text:
He breaketh this commandement,
THat thinkes but a thought in his mind tending to the dishonour and cō
tempt of his neighbour.
That mockes or reuiles, or beates his superiours. Gen. 9.22.
That disobeyes their lawfull commandements. Rom. 1.30.
That is vnthankefull to parents, and will not releeue them if neede be. 2. Tim. 3.3.
That disobeyes God to obey them. Act. 4.19.
That exalts himselfe aboue the magistrate. 2. Thess. 2.9.
That serues his master with eie seruice. Coloss. 3.22.
That gouerns his family and those which are vnder him negligently. 1. Tim. 3.4.
That is slacke in punishing faults. 1. Sam. 2.22.
That is too rigorous in speeches and punishments. Eph. 6.9.
That marrieth without parents consent.
That chooseth his calling without parents consent. Num. 30.
That thinkes better of himselfe then of others. Rom. 12.10.
That despiseth aged persons. Lev. 19.23.
